tools.name: check_package
tools.description: Verify a package exists on PyPI or npm before importing/installing it (anti-slopsquatting)

tools.name: verify_install
tools.description: Check every package in an install command (pip/npm/yarn/pnpm/uv) before running it

tools.name: sast_scan
tools.description: Scan a code snippet for insecure patterns (injection, hardcoded secrets, insecure defaults)

tools.name: sca_scan
tools.description: Check pinned dependency versions (requirements.txt) for known CVEs

tools.name: full_scan
tools.description: Run package, SAST and SCA checks together and return one blocking decision

tools.name: scan_repo
tools.description: Full multi-tool security scan on a project directory (needs the pipeline; degrades on a bare install)
